ROW.COLUMN: (FR/CU) Bust Out: Sudden Surge in Revolving Credit Utilization

A sudden surge in Revolving Credit Utilization activities by customers may be suspicious and potentially fraudulent which might warrant additional investigation. This scenario detects sudden surge in Revolving Credit Utilization activity and maxing out or closing near maximum limit in short periods of time.
